messages:
sam: Quick async check-in for kernel + continuous batching + KV work — drop blockers and ownerships here pls.
lia: Heads up — kernel PR #482 landed in draft, waiting perf harness results. I own lifting to canary once CI is green.
noah: Question: does the batching change require any router fallback changes? I thought we had a policy that routes small seqs to fastpath.
irene: @noah yes — we need a tiny router tweak or a policy flag. I can take the router-side patch (should be ~2 files).
rachel: CI flake on gpu-npm job, re-running. not related to perf changes but holding the canary until green. :crossed_fingers:
sam: Action list: (1) lia -> run perf harness + paste numbers here (2) irene -> prepare router flag PR (3) noah -> validate SLO regression tests for small seqs (4) rachel -> confirm CI unblock.
lia: Perf harness results (short run): kernel+batching branch shows median p50 token latency +6% on small seqs, -18% on 512 tokens. Throughput +28% for batched workload. Paste raw: ```p50: 62ms -> 66ms (+6%)
p95: 210ms -> 198ms (-5.7%)
throughput: 4200 -> 5380 reqs/s (+28%)```
noah: That aligns w/ expectations. Small-seq p50 delta is the router concern. If we can route 0-64 to old path when latency-sensitive, that'd keep SLOs.
irene: Router flag PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pull/789. Adds config flag `prefer_fastpath_for_short`. Default off. Need eng-runtime approval to enable.
sam: Who can review router PR quickly? We should toggle flag only in canary nodes.
rachel: I can review in ~30m. After CI passes here I'll merge the kernel draft to a canary branch and flip the flag for one region.
lia: Also note KV cache warmup improvement landed in my branch — reduces cold start token cost by ~12%. Noah, that changes eviction tests slightly.
noah: I'll update eviction unit tests tomorrow morning. For now, can we gate the canary on passing regression suite?
irene: Yes — the router flag + canary region will be the rollout plan. We should add a quick smoke: send 10k short seq requests and validate 99th percentile < 300ms.
sam: Agreed. Timeline: rachel merges CI fixes (T+0.5h), lia promotes perf branch to canary (T+1h), irene flips flag on canary (T+1.5h), noah runs regression + smoke (T+2h). If all green, gradual rollout.
ci-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for eng-runtime/canary-region-1. build: r482-kbatch-2026. status: queued.
rachel: CI is green and flake fixed. merging now.
lia: Promoted canary build -> https://canary.internal/redwood/build/482-kbatch-2026. Logs look sane.
noah: Starting regression run (short + long seqs). posting results in this thread.
irene: Router flag flipped on canary. monitoring dashboards: token latency spike expected for short seqs until routing kicks in. Endpoint: https://dash.internal/runtime/canary-1
sam: Thanks folks. If any blocker arises, ping here and we'll roll back. Otherwise I'll open a follow-up thread for post-canary analysis with sample traces and Kv hit/miss breakdown.
noah: Regression quick summary: short seq p50 within target after router flag, p95 285ms, KV hit-rate improved with warmup patch. No regressions found in long seqs.
rachel: Nice. I'll schedule a retrospective tomorrow to capture learnings (5–10 mins). Please add notes to the retro doc.
sam: Closing loop: owners: lia (perf + canary), irene (router flag + rollback), noah (regressions/tests), rachel (CI + merge). Thanks all :thumbsup:
